description: Submit an authenticated request for parent evaluation, a birth permit, Nursery evaluation or lifecycle transition. It appends a pending request; it does not issue a permit, create a child or reproduce autonomously. Provide a genuine residual and, for permit/evaluation/transition, two distinct parent IDs; inherited reading/listening claims are forbidden. Use inspect_cassie_lineage for existing state. A pending receipt is not approval.

child_agent_id.description: Optional existing child ID when requesting an evaluation/transition; it does not create an identity.

idempotency_key.description: Required stable key (8–160 characters) for retry-safe request recording.

inherited_findings.description: Optional array of at most 50 finding records to be reviewed; do not encode experience claims as inherited.

listening_claim_inherited.description: Must remain false; personal listening experience cannot be inherited.

operation.description: Required request type: propose_parents, request_permit, record_nursery_evaluation or transition_lifecycle.

parent_ids.description: Required for every operation: exactly two distinct existing parent agent IDs from public lineage discovery. Requests are recorded pending review; they do not create an identity.

reading_claim_inherited.description: Must remain false; reading experience cannot be inherited.

requested_stage.description: Optional requested lifecycle stage from the listed enum; it is a request, not an applied transition.

residual.description: Required unresolved problem/residual, 20–2000 characters, that the proposed step addresses.

name: request_cassie_birth
title: Request a controlled Cassie child
